To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SWEET 14 is a key regulator of grain weight, grain length and width in rice and is also an important factor in rice resistance to sheaths blight disease.
SWEET11 is a key factor for rice defense to R. solanic.
SWEET genes are involved in rice defense against R. solani, and tissue-specific activation of DOF1.1 promotes rice resistance to R. solanii via activation of S. 14.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the function of SWEETs in the rice–R. solani interaction and the role of the transcriptional activator DOF11 in regulating SWEET14 and PBZ1 expression.
the role of SUGAR WILL EVENTUALLY BE EXPORTED (SWEET14) in rice resistance to sheaths blight disease (SBD).
the following questions: 1) Does SWEET14 contribute to the rice response to R. solanii infection?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
R. solanii infection induces the expression of SWEET and PBZ1 in rice.
SWEET11, SWEET14, and SWEETS are important for rice resistance to ShB disease and grain weight.
R. solanii infection activates SWEET14 in rice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SWEET 14 is a key player during R. solani and rice interaction and it can be used as a target to improve rice resistance against R. solani.
we identified a new role for SWEET14 as an important regulator of rice resistance to ShB disease and a new tissue-specific function for DOF11.
we identified a novel tissue-specific transcription factor, DOF11, that promotes SWEET14 transcription and increases rice grain weight.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SWEET 14 plays an important role in the defense response of rice to R. solanii infection.

DOF11, a DOF transcription factor, is involved in regulating SWEET14 and PBZ1 expression in response to R. solan infection (Figure 1b) In addition, we also found that the DOF11 binding site was present in the promoter region of SWEET11 (Figure 1c) However, the function of DOF11 in SWEET11 expression was not verified in this work.
SWEET genes are involved in rice defense response and the regulation of rice grain development.
